title: US Cancels G20 Family Photo After European Countries Refuse to Stand With Russia
excerpt: A diplomatic disagreement involving Russia has disrupted the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta after the United States cancelled its traditional group photograph. Several countries had threatened to boycott the picture rather than stand alongside Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov.
author: LokkeeVerse
content:
The United States has cancelled the traditional group photograph at the G20 foreign ministers' meeting after several participating countries objected to appearing alongside Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov.

The disagreement occurred during the gathering in Atlanta, Georgia, on Friday, October 30, 2026.

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio decided to cancel the photograph after learning that several European representatives, alongside officials from the United Kingdom and Australia, were unwilling to participate in a picture with the Russian foreign minister.

The decision avoided a potentially embarrassing situation in which multiple delegations could have refused to join the official event.

However, the disagreement highlighted the continuing diplomatic tensions surrounding Russia's participation in international meetings.

## Why Did Countries Object to Appearing With Russia?

The objections were connected to Russia's ongoing war against Ukraine and the diplomatic disagreements surrounding Moscow's international relations.

Several European governments have maintained that normal diplomatic appearances alongside Russian officials would send the wrong message while the conflict continues.

German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul reportedly argued that there could be no return to normal relations with Russia under the current circumstances.

The United Kingdom also indicated that it would not participate in the photograph alongside Russian representatives.

Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski supported the cancellation, describing it as the appropriate decision.

The disagreement demonstrated how the war in Ukraine continues to influence diplomatic relationships beyond the countries directly involved.

## Marco Rubio Leads the G20 Discussions

Despite the controversy, the foreign ministers' meeting continued.

Rubio opened the discussions by highlighting the importance of international cooperation at a time of major geopolitical and economic challenges.

He described the current international environment as a critical moment for the global community.

Issues surrounding international security, trade, economic stability and regional conflicts were among the major subjects facing participating countries.

However, the disagreement over the photograph showed how difficult it can be for major economies to agree on even symbolic diplomatic activities.

## Why Is Russia Still Participating in the G20?

Russia remains a member of the G20, a forum that brings together major economies to discuss international economic and financial issues.

The group includes countries with different political systems, diplomatic interests and positions on international conflicts.

Although several governments have criticised Moscow's actions in Ukraine, Russia continues to participate in the forum.

This creates diplomatic challenges when countries with opposing positions are expected to attend the same meetings.

The latest controversy is another example of how international political disagreements can affect the operation of multilateral organisations.

## South Africa Also Missing From the Meeting

Another issue attracting attention was the absence of South Africa from the gathering.

South Africa is a founding member of the G20 and the only African country with permanent membership.

The United States did not invite the country to participate in the meeting, a decision that attracted criticism from South African officials.

A spokesperson for South Africa's international relations department said the country's non-participation was not voluntary.

The development has raised further questions about representation and disagreements within the international economic forum.

## Could the Disagreement Affect the Next G20 Summit?

The foreign ministers' meeting is taking place ahead of a G20 leaders' summit scheduled to be hosted by US President Donald Trump in Florida in December.

The disagreement over the photograph could make it more difficult for participating governments to agree on a joint statement covering major international issues.

However, the meeting itself has not been cancelled.

Diplomats are still expected to discuss international trade, security, economic cooperation and other matters affecting the global economy.

## What Happens Next?

The cancellation of the group photograph has become a visible symbol of the diplomatic tensions surrounding Russia's participation in international forums.

The United States and other participating countries will now face the challenge of maintaining diplomatic discussions despite their disagreements.

The outcome of the Atlanta meeting could provide an indication of how effectively the G20 can cooperate ahead of its next leaders' summit.
